definitions.gloss: regular event, established custom, annual tradition
definitions.explanation: An event or practice that takes place regularly as an established tradition. Implies something that happens on a fixed schedule and has become customary.

examples.japanese: {恒例|こうれい}の{夏祭|なつまつ}りが{今年|ことし}も{開|ひら}かれる。
examples.english: The annual summer festival will be held again this year.

examples.japanese: {年末|ねんまつ}{恒例|こうれい}の{大掃除|おおそうじ}をした。
examples.english: We did the year-end cleaning, as is customary.

examples.japanese: {恒例|こうれい}の{行事|ぎょうじ}として、{毎年|まいとし}{四月|しがつ}にお{花見|はなみ}{会|かい}を{開催|かいさい}している。
examples.english: As an established tradition, we hold a cherry blossom viewing party every April.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a の-adjective to modify nouns: {恒例|こうれい}の{行事|ぎょうじ} (regular event). Very common in news reports and announcements about recurring events.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {恒例|こうれい}の{行事|ぎょうじ}: regular event
- {年末|ねんまつ}{恒例|こうれい}: year-end tradition
- {毎年|まいとし}{恒例|こうれい}: annual tradition
- {恒例|こうれい}となっている: has become a tradition
